summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for persistent right shoulder pain following treatment for group B strep sepsis and polyarticular septic arthritis. Imaging revealed a lucency in the right humeral head suggestive of osteomyelitis. He underwent an incision and drainage procedure on 2174-07-31 under general anesthesia, tolerated it well, and had an uncomplicated postoperative course. Pain was managed with a transition from PCA to oral narcotics, and he was cleared for discharge to extended care on postoperative day one. He continues on clindamycin for infection, with instructions to perform pendulum exercises, keep the wound dry, and monitor for signs of complications. His cirrhosis and ascites were noted but stable during admission.
